thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service `inference-queue-throughput` (critical) - reason: sustained queue length > 12k for 6m, average dequeue latency 4.2s :rotating_light:

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2026-7890 created and routed to schedule `eng-oncall-primary`. Pager: Asha (oncall)

Asha (oncall): acked. i'm taking first touch. pulling metrics now.

Marek: noticed CPU on the autoscaler controller spiking ~90% earlier. could be reconcile thrash.

Sofia: heads up, customer-visible: some small percentage of requests to hosted inference are seeing 5-10s tail latencies, sampling shows enqueued times high. CS got one customer DM.

Asha (oncall): good. quick checklist: 1) confirm autoscaler DNS / API calls are healthy 2) check node pool quota 3) check k/v cache pressure 4) consider manual warmup/provision if autoscaler not reacting

Li: sharing prometheus queries: `sum(queue_length) by (cell)` and `rate(controller_reconcile_duration_seconds[5m])`. cell-3 is the hotspot.

Asha (oncall): running `kubectl get deploy autoscaler-controller -n infra -o wide` -> `RESTARTS 0, AGE 14d`, but controller CPU is high on grafana. grabbing logs.

Sofia: past deploy? there was a small runtime roll 2h ago that changed reconcile backoff, maybe correlated.

Marek: logs from controller: `E controller: failed to scale group: quota exceeded: insufficient nodes` repeated. see snippet: ```
I0312 14:10:12.345 controller.go:212] Scale attempt failed: quotaExceeded
I0312 14:10:13.876 controller.go:212] Scale attempt failed: quotaExceeded
```

Asha (oncall): quotaExceeded -> could be cloud provider quota or nodepool max. Li, can you check cloud quota and nodepool limits?

Li: cloud quotas look fine for cores; nodepool `inference-gpu-pool` has max=120 and current=120. autoscaler can't create more.

Grace: we have a soft quota in our internal placement service that prevents >16 active cells on that pool due to topology. cell-3 hit the limit and spillover is queuing.

Asha (oncall): OK that explains backlog. mitigation options: a) bump pool max (fast but requires infra approval and might be slow), b) spin up burst `cpu-backed` workers that can process low-priority batch inference (could relieve some queue), c) route new requests to fallback model variant with lower resource per-token.

Sofia: fallback routing is enabled for the API but not for some internal customer routes. we can flip on global fallback (low latency risk) while we scale.

Marek: i can open a temporary nodepool increase request — but provision time ~8-12m. we should start now.

Asha (oncall): start both: Marek submit nodepool bump to 160, Grace start a small batch worker fleet (cpu) to drain non-urgent queue, Sofia enable global fallback for public API routes. Li monitor queue drain. I'll keep incident updated and communicate to CS.

Marek: submitted quota bump to infra-ops: ticket TKT-4523 — request +40 GPUs to `inference-gpu-pool`.

cs-bridge-bot: Notifying Customer Success: elevated latencies for inference; advised mitigation in progress.

Grace: spinning up batch workers: using job template `batch-drainer-v2`. starting 20 replicas now. command: ```
kubectl apply -f batch-drainer-v2.yaml -n batch
```

Asha (oncall): Sofia, flip fallback now. note in audit: `api-routing: enable-fallback=on`

Sofia: done. routing change pushed, traffic rebalanced. expected immediate drop for new requests.

Li: metrics: queue length plateaued then starting to drop on cell-3 from 12.4k -> 9.1k after batch workers + fallback (5m). dequeue latency down to 2.1s.

Marek: infra approved nodepool bump, cloud provisioning started. k8s nodes requested: +18, expected ready ~9m.

Asha (oncall): good. please leave notes in incident doc: actions and playbook steps. i'll run a quick RCA checklist: what changed before spike? runtime roll 2h ago altering reconcile backoff — maybe combined with sudden traffic from customer X.

Sofia: confirmed a traffic surge from a scheduled A/B experiment around 13:55 that increased long-context requests by ~3x to that cell.

Marek: nodepool came up: 18 nodes joined, autoscaler controller reconciles now showing successful scale ops. logs: `I controller: scale group succeeded, added 18 nodes`

Li: queue steadily decreasing: 9.1k -> 1.2k over next 6m. dequeue latency 0.6s.

Asha (oncall): marking incident status -> mitigated. leaving PD incident open for postmortem.

Grace: recommend followups: - revert fallback routing when capacity stable - evaluate reconcile backoff change in runtime roll - add runbook step to detect nodepool soft limits earlier - add alert that ties queue length to nodepool headroom (not just absolute queue)

Sofia: i'll notify product + customer success for post-incident comms. CS, expect note to customers about transient latency and rollback not required.

cs-bridge-bot: CS notified; draft sent to customers impacted: 4 tenants flagged.

Asha (oncall): handing back to infra for postmortem. tag: @Marek @Grace @Sofia for followups. thanks team :heart:

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-7890 status: mitigated - assigned to owner Marek for postmortem.
